CLCMsg_ListenEvents::EventCount._comment: Offset of the int element-count of the listen-bits event array inside CLCMsg_ListenEvents. Windows: start of the CUtlVector<uint32> (count at +0x0 of the vector at 0x48 -> 0x48). Linux: separate count field at 0x48. Both verified from ListenBitsReceived.

CLCMsg_ListenEvents::EventData._comment: Offset of the pointer to the uint32 word array holding the listen bits. Windows: the CUtlVector's data pointer sits at vector+0x8 (0x48+0x8 = 0x50). Linux: a direct pointer field at 0x50. Both verified from ListenBitsReceived (Windows reads CUtlVector@0x48; Linux reads count@0x48 + ptr@0x50).

CGameEventManager::GetEventDescriptor._comment: bool/ptr GetEventDescriptor(CGameEventManager* this, const char* name, int* outBitIndex). Resolves an event name to its descriptor and writes the event's listen-bit index into *outBitIndex (Windows ORs bit 31 as a flag; mask with 0x7FFFFFFF). Used at init to translate blacklisted event names into bit indices. Windows verified from server.dll, Linux from libserver.so (sub_17705A0).
